latestTerminalSummary:
I scored 13 of the 14 values at 10. The exception is Composition and spacing, which gets 9.5 in both light and dark. This is one reviewer's opinion, not a joint pass.

| Category | Light | Dark |
|---|---:|---:|
| Typography | 10 | 10 |
| Composition and spacing | 9.5 | 9.5 |
| Color harmony | 10 | 10 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 10 | 10 |
| Component visual consistency | 10 | 10 |
| Responsive visual polish | 10 | 10 |
| Tag workflow clarity and feedback | 10 | 10 |

**The one blocker to 10:** on desktop, the "Add existing tag" row sticks out past the 320px column that every other tag control lines up to. The select fills the column (x=234–554) and the Add button sits outside it (x=562–635). At 320 wide the same row fits inside the column. The fix is to cap that row at 320px and let the select shrink, as it already does on phones. Run Log can't show this because all its tags are attached; I saw it in the isolated sample.

**Candidate check:** the scoped diff and working tree against `235a5c9e` were empty at entry and cleanup. Both servers loaded only assets `b1f015b9d4bf`. `bin/server` and both running servers have the hash `3e9cf847…`.

**What I actually viewed:**
- **Run Log:** all 16 core panel and sheet states across the four sizes, in light and dark. Both color-scheme media checks matched the emulated scheme at every pair.
- **Isolated sample (incognito):** the four required pairs. I selected Utilities and restored the placeholder each time without pressing Add.

**Earlier objections:**
- **Original screenshot defects (resolved):** the check badge against the corner, the stretched capsule and the ambiguous mobile Save are all fixed.
- **Rejected-name Enter bug from round 34:** fixed in source. Edit now uses the same guard as Create (`web/gallery/tags.js:280`). I confirmed this by reading the code; I did not press Enter or trigger a rejection.
- **Invalid hex and blank-name states:** both show red borders, errors in place of the hints, and a neutral swatch, keep Save disabled, and don't move the dialog.
- **Keyboard and dismissal:** arrow keys move the color selection, Escape returns focus to the pencil that opened the sheet, and the Delete tag… → Keep tag confirmation works.

**Not exercised:** any valid save, create, add, remove or delete; the pending, success or error outcomes; the native color dialog; and the optional 320×640 and 640×360 sheets.

**Cleanup:** all temporary edits were restored and neither tab made any tag API requests. Run Log reloads clean with its original four tags and colors. I reset both tabs to the system appearance and closed only my own two. The report is the only file I wrote: `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-35-opus-tags-ten.md`.
